evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep said: 'To get you on the right track that should take about five to ten minutes and we'll be able to build you an accurate code you can depend on, sounds good.' — Time-boxed promise of dependable quote present, but rep pivoted immediately into probing ('Let's talk about your move') without clear wait for a yes.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Rep asked: 'What or do you have any concerns or any important things that you wanted to answer during this call today?' — Asked after availability confirmation and some initial probing (moving day, storage size, square footage already discussed).
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer replied 'I don't think so' to concerns question. No concerns raised, so N/A applies.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: No reflection summary offered. Customer raised no concerns, so N/A applies.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Rep gathered: property type (house), floor/stories (one story for first stop; three stories for final destination), rooms/bedrooms (3 bedrooms at final), walking distance/parking (driveway available), special considerations (heavy items, valuable/fragile artwork, elevators at storage), additional stops (three distinct locations confirmed). All seven items covered.
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Rep asked: 'How many boxes are we moving?' Customer clarified no boxes from first stop, two boxes from storage units.
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Not offered. Rep never asked if customer wanted packing services.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Rep provided: 'A typical storage for 10x10. Normally it takes two movers that is between four to six hours... estimated cost would be $2,704... between five and a half to six and a half hours.' Anchored to typical time/cost range AND personalized to customer's specific move (two storage units, three-story destination, under 15 min distance, some heavy items). Full anchor and personalization present.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Rep disclosed: hourly rate ($104/mover), truck/gas/insurance/tools/wraps/pods included, no hidden fees (explicitly stated three times), trip fee concept absent but morning-appointment window mentioned. Minimum 2.5 hours and 15-minute increments covered: 'minimum of twenty half hours... prorated into fifteen minute increments.' Fee transparency and minimum/increment commitment both present.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Rep never asked 'Does that feel fair?' or equivalent. Moved directly to time window confirmation without soliciting customer reaction to pricing.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: Rep stated: 'we have on time guarantee we value your time. So, if you cannot make it to the time window that we arrange, we immediately start discounting money of your final bill.' Discount-starts-immediately framing clearly present. Full delivery.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: Rep stated: 'we have no worry damage coverage included on the R-D rate that you're paying us. We will provide up to $2,000 per mem that is to be pair replaced and Reis for your items.' Coverage amount and inclusion-in-rate stated, but 'no deductible / no fine print' framing not explicitly delivered. Partial delivery.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: Rep did not ask 'Does that put those to rest?' or similar confirmatory close after covering both promises. No loop closure attempted.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Rep asked: 'Do you still have other concerns that you want us to answer during this call before I let you go?' Genuine version asked (not empty 'any questions?'). Full.
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Rep never asked 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' or equivalent. Not asked.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Rep asked: 'would you like our help with your move for tomorrow?' — plainly asked, no softened-out language ('or I can just email this over'). Full.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: Rep stated: 'where in there is no deposit required. No recent securing your spot.' Rate lock (no deposit, no commitment until job done) clearly mentioned.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Rep confirmed: date (Thursday, October 1st), time window (8:30 to 9:00 AM), crew size (two trucks), and promised confirmation email. Missing: phone number reconfirmation for final booking, specific pickup address (first stop address 6800 Glen Ridge), final destination address reconfirmed, and crew notes about customer concerns (heavy furniture, valuable items, need for adequate crew size). Partial — some details confirmed, others missing or not explicitly locked in on call.

top_strength: Excellent logistics probing — rep systematically gathered property type, floor count, room count, parking access, accessibility concerns, and special item details across three locations, building a comprehensive move picture that directly informed the estimate.
coaching_note: Do not skip 'Does that feel fair?' after pricing — it's the critical moment to surface objections before moving to close, and rep talked over the silence by immediately re-framing time-based billing instead of pausing for customer reaction.
